cases.name: persisted nikto command with repeated options
cases.input: (command -v nikto >/dev/null 2>&1 && nikto -nointeractive -Format xml -output old.xml -nointeractive -host https://example.test:8443 -NoInteractive -C all) || echo nikto not found
cases.expected: (command -v nikto >/dev/null 2>&1 && nikto -nointeractive -Format txt -output [OUTPUT].txt -h [WEB_URL] -C all) || echo nikto not found

cases.expected: (command -v nikto >/dev/null 2>&1 && nikto -nointeractive -Format txt -output [OUTPUT].txt -h [WEB_URL]) || echo nikto not found
